other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal objective function for count data
other_failure_modes.description: The target variable represents a discrete count (e.g., rented bikes), which is often better modeled using a Poisson or negative binomial objective function. Using standard Gaussian regression requires manual clipping of negative predictions and may not capture the variance properties of count data.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline with domain-aware post-processing (zeroing predictions on non-functioning days). However, it critically fails by using randomized cross-validation on a time-series dataset, which leaks future information into the training folds. Furthermore, it models count data using a standard regression objective rather than a count-specific objective like Poisson regression.
